preconditions.description: The input `msg` must be a string.

postconditions.description: If the input string `msg` is empty, the output must be an empty string.

postconditions.expression: all(c in msg for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every character in the output string must be present in the input string `msg`.
The output string must contain no duplicate characters.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] != return_value[j] for i in range(len(return_value)) for j in range(i + 1, len(return_value)) if abs(ord(return_value[i]) - ord(return_value[j])) == 1)
postconditions.description: No two adjacent characters in the output string (in terms of ASCII value) can be consecutive in the output sequence.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] in msg for i in range(len(return_value)))
postconditions.description: The output string must be a subsequence of the input string `msg`.

postconditions.expression: all(ord(return_value[i]) > ord(return_value[i + 1]) for i in range(len(return_value) - 1))
postconditions.description: The output string must be sorted in descending order of ASCII values.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] in msg for i in range(len(return_value))) and all(msg.find(return_value[i]) < msg.find(return_value[i + 1]) if msg.find(return_value[i]) != -1 and msg.find(return_value[i + 1]) != -1 else True for i in range(len(return_value) - 1))
postconditions.description: The output string must be a subsequence of `msg` where the characters appear in the same order as in `msg` (preserving their relative positions).
